# A state var with a @change handler that calls an async native produces
# an async $set_X setter in the generated JS.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# The setter for the state var with an async @change handler is async.
grep 'async function \$set_count' out/index.html

# The async native is awaited inside the setter body.
grep 'await fetchHello' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import api "js:./api"

component main {
    var count = 0 @change {
        api.fetchHello("updated")
    }
    button(text="Go", @click { count = count + 1 })
    text(value=string(count))
}

-- api/index.ts --
export async function fetchHello(msg: string): Promise<string> { return msg; }
